title: Using Agentic AI for contextualized and multifaceted code review at Ericsson
abstract: arXiv:2609.15877v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Context: Conducting effective code reviews is increasingly challenging due to the growing complexity of software systems and the accelerated code generation by AI coding agents. LLM-based approaches for code reviews have shown promising results in identifying defects and improving code quality. However, existing approaches rarely consider project-specific contextualized knowledge, and few have been evaluated in industrial settings.   Objective: In this study, we propose a multi-agent-based solution that provides multifaceted assessments of code changes.   Method: Following the Design Science Research Process, we developed and evaluated our solution in an industrial setting. Our solution combines specialized agent skills with context-specific knowledge to identify antipatterns in code changes across four dimensions: readability, maintainability, reliability, and performance. translated_title: 在爱立信使用智能体AI进行情境化和多维度的代码评审
translated_abstract: 背景：由于软件系统日益复杂以及AI编码智能体加速生成代码，进行有效的代码评审变得愈发具有挑战性。基于大语言模型（LLM）的代码评审方法在识别缺陷和提升代码质量方面已展现出良好的效果。然而，现有方法很少考虑项目特定的情境化知识，且鲜有方法在工业环境中得到评估。目标：在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于多智能体的解决方案，可对代码变更提供多维度的评估。方法：遵循设计科学研究流程，我们在工业环境中开发并评估了该解决方案。我们的方案将专门的智能体技能与情境化知识相结合，从四个维度——可读性、可维护性、可靠性和性能——识别代码变更中的反模式。使用该解决方案，我们为多个代码提交生成了评审意见。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种在爱立信工业环境中开发并评估的多智能体AI代码评审方案，通过将专门的智能体技能与项目情境化知识相结合，从可读性、可维护性、可靠性和性能四个维度对代码变更进行多方面评估。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a multi-agent AI code review solution developed and evaluated at Ericsson, which combines specialized agent skills with project-specific contextual knowledge to provide multifaceted assessments of code changes across readability, maintainability, reliability, and performance dimensions.
